description: This file provides configuration functions for tenant salt, tenant identification, and JWT settings, used in authentication and authorization processes within a backend system.

methods.name: getTenantSaltConfig
methods.description: Returns status flags about the SECRET_SALT environment variable without exposing the secret.

methods.name: getTenantConfig
methods.description: Provides tenant resolution and validation based on request headers, auth middleware, or default environment settings.

methods.name: getJwtConfig
methods.description: Provides JWT configuration parameters from environment variables with fallback defaults.
